event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil crash, cyclicals ripped.
ADP printed 8.6 vs 6.9 fc and ISM Services 54.5 vs 54.8 fc: growth holding, but the tape was a rotation, not a Fed trade. Crude's -8% collapse (EIA draw -86.5 vs +198.7 fc) pulled money into every non-energy cyclical — XLY +4.26%, XLF +3.51% — while SOXX -3.14% and XLE -4.74% bled. DIA +3.10% on 2.0x volume says real buying, not a squeeze.

INDICES — VIX 16.6, below its 17.6 20-day MA.
DIA +3.10%, SPY +1.65%, IWM +1.51%, QQQ +0.97%, SOXX -3.14%. Large > small by only 0.14pp — a mega-cap Dow day, not a breadth day. Most notable cross-asset move: USO -8.07%, with SLV +5.17% the mirror image. SPY remains below its 20-day trend (-1.34% 20d); watch 770 GEX flip.

VOLUME & BREADTH — DIA 2.0x and RSP 1.8x on the gaining side is accumulation.
SPY and QQQ vol_ratio are not flagged elevated; the attention sat in XLY 2.4x and XLE 2.1x — discretionary accumulation, energy distribution. Breadth confirms: 72% of S&P above the 50-DMA, 65% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 363/139, up/down volume 1.65, new 60d highs 139 vs 37 lows. Participation is broad, not a narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLY Discretionary +4.26%, XLF Financials +3.51%, XLC Comms +3.47%, XLP Staples +3.36%, XLRE Real Estate +3.32%, XLV Healthcare +3.06%, XLB Materials +2.49%, XLU Utilities +0.44%, XLK Technology -0.01%, XLI Industrials -1.09%, XLE Energy -4.74%.
Top industries GDX +9.01% and SILJ +8.97%; bottom XOP -6.39% and WGMI -8.59%. Flows: XLF +916 (92p) and XLV +723 (94p) lead inflows; XLP -366 (15p) and XLY -154 (29p) bleed — financials/healthcare inflows confirm the price ranking, XLY's outflow contradicts its +4.26% (short-covering risk). Money out of energy and AI hardware into financials, healthcare and precious metals. Label: high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.53 is heavy protection demand against a +1.65% tape; QQQ skew +8.1% shows post-SOXX put buying.
SPY sits below its 770 gamma flip with spot pressure into that level — dealer hedging amplifies moves. VIXEQ 41.2 vs VIX 16.6 is a huge gap: extreme single-stock dispersion, a stock-pickers' tape, not macro-correlated.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude -8% on a surprise EIA draw transmitted straight into XLE -4.74% and XOP -6.39%, while silver +5.17% and gold +3.68% caught the dollar's -0.38% slip. TLT +0.80% and HYG +0.70% confirm the risk-on bid. Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%; Polymarket 78% YES for +25bp, +7pp in 5 days — a hawkish drift into the meeting.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 58.5, Neutral.
Movers: VST -13.83% on completing the Cogentrix ~5,500 MW acquisition (3.2x vol — distribution into the deal), VRT -12.89%, WPM +11.99%, GOLD +5.90% ahead of Wheaton's Nov 5 Q3 report. Momentum extremes: XLY +9.85% 20d best, XLK -12.36% worst. Watch VST (3.2x vol, -13.83%, Power 7 unwind), SOXX (5d -13.70%, 100th-pctile inflows vs -3.14% price — divergence), SLV (PCR 0.26, flip 46, max pain 45.5).
